task: Prevent new keyed Granite submissions from reusing reports graded by the former evidence validator.
nonGoals: No deployment, parser or frontend change, D1 migration, cache duration or usage policy change, or change to the existing assessment job identity.

outcomes.description: A cached legacy report does not prevent a fresh audit on the new scoring path; reports already built by the new path continue to use the normal cache.
outcomes.evidence: Seed old cache key in D1, verify new queue dispatch, old report remains readable, and a subsequent submission reuses the new report.

process.description: Verify in an isolated worktree and obtain independent review before release.
process.evidence: Separate plan, evaluation, review and PR.

styleEfficiency.description: Extend the existing cache fingerprint only for the affected policy.

exitTest.reason: The fix changes only cache lookup identity. It leaves jobs, queue checkpoints and resume behavior unchanged.
